LanguageData.DMS_ArsenalSite.label: old arsenal
LanguageData.DMS_ArsenalSite.description: A semi-underground bunker complex once run by the vanguard colonists stationed in this region. As their mission changed, the bunkers were emptied over several relocations and then abandoned; what was left inside is equipment too awkward to move or past its service life, and some of those stores may still be there. The unmanned security system is still running, though, so breaking in carries risks no one can predict.\n\nThe facility is patrolled by one to five gravekeepers. The bunker seals are slaved to the life signs of an old but still devastating ultra-heavy bipedal automatroid: the decoy radar on the central pad can call a tarbosaurus in, and if we want to strip the bunkers it has to be destroyed first.
LanguageData.DMS_ArsenalSite.arrivedLetter: You have arrived at the old arsenal. A fence of steel posts and barbed wire rings the compound; inside, watchtowers cover the roads between the bunkers and the wrecks of old outbuildings, and gravekeepers walk their rounds.\n\nThe bunker seals answer to a tarbosaurus's life signs. The decoy radar on the central pad can call one in; the seals release once it is destroyed.
